🌐 A High‑Security Network Engineering Experience at VASS Romania 
 Stepping into this role means stepping into a space where technology, trust, and international collaboration converge. It’s an environment shaped by secure connectivity, advanced architectures, and the responsibility of supporting infrastructures that matter.
 ✨ What This Experience Brings (Benefits & Value) 
A chance to work within high‑security, mission‑critical environments where your expertise directly supports international operations.
Exposure to FastConnect/IPsec architectures , Cisco LAN , and firewall ecosystems that define secure connectivity at scale.
A multicultural setting where English C1 is your bridge to global collaboration.
The opportunity to operate in contexts where NATO nationality and PSC clearance elevate your professional profile.
A role centered in Eastern Europe , with the possibility to influence and support infrastructures across other regions.
A community that values precision, resilience, and engineering excellence—where your decisions genuinely matter.
 🔧 What Your Day‑to‑Day Feels Like 
 Your daily routine blends technical depth with strategic impact:
Navigating secure network environments where every configuration contributes to stability and protection.
Designing, maintaining, and optimizing FastConnect/IPsec‑based connectivity for high‑trust organizations.
Working hands‑on with Cisco LAN infrastructures and firewall technologies to ensure seamless, secure operations.
Collaborating with international teams, sharing insights, and aligning on connectivity strategies.
Troubleshooting complex network scenarios where your expertise becomes the difference between disruption and continuity.
Ensuring that every connection, every route, and every security layer meets the standards required in sensitive environments.
 🛠 Key Responsibilities (What You’ll Shape and Deliver) 
Build and maintain secure network architectures using FastConnect/IPsec.
Configure and optimize Cisco LAN , routing, switching, and firewall components.
Strengthen secure connectivity across distributed environments and international stakeholders.
Support high‑security infrastructures with precision, documentation, and proactive monitoring.
Ensure compliance with security protocols and operational frameworks required in NATO‑aligned contexts.
Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives that enhance resilience and performance.
 🎯 Requirements (Your Professional Passport) 
 NATO nationality — mandatory.
 English C1 — essential for daily collaboration.
 PSC (security clearance) — required; already having it is a strong advantage.
Solid experience with FastConnect , IPsec , Cisco LAN , and firewall technologies .
Background in secure connectivity, network engineering, or high‑trust environments.
Based in Eastern Europe or open to relocation; other regions may be considered.
